name: Marwan ibn Abi Hafsa
bio: Marwan grew up in al-Yamama in a family attached to the Umayyads and later sought patronage at the Abbasid court in Baghdad. He praised Ma'n ibn Za'ida, al-Mahdi and Harun al-Rashid, making descent and kinship part of the case for his patrons. Al-Tanukhi records a reward of a hundred thousand dirhams for his ode to al-Mahdi beginning with a visit in a dream. He died in Baghdad in 182 AH (798 CE).
